opening.argument: The presentation lays out a 10 BUSD entry into Forsage x3 and x4, then ties the structure to referrals, team-building, and payouts. The speaker says, “as soon as you refer a third person because your structure is full, you do not have to invest money again on your structure. So by default this reinvestment happens.” A slide separately shows a 5 BUSD upline payment and “Unlimited Recycle again and again.” This is a recruitment-based business plan: participants are directed into referral structures where payments and continued recycling depend on additional people. The material presents those structures as a benefit, alongside claims of rapid, 100 percent payment. It promotes the plan rather than reporting on or criticizing it; the evidence establishes the solicitation, not any participant’s actual losses or outcome.
